recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is; no FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a later work-group decision wants additional editorial refinement or formal constraints around interface implementation.
issue_request: FHIR-51035 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-I change request asking to stop describing CanonicalResource and MetadataResource interfaces as valid additional-resource baseDefinition targets, and instead limit baseDefinition to Resource or DomainResource with interface adherence indicated by structuredefinition-implements.
initial_application: Commit 7ed65aada432055f2636f94596f6a6ead546ddc2, 'FHIR-51035 Interfaces are not valid base types', changed source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-notes.xml from the four-name list to Resource or DomainResource plus an implements-extension sentence.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active structuredefinition=StructureDefinition entry, so the StructureDefinition notes source is in current build scope. FHIR-I 2025-06-09 minutes record the same Persuasive motion at 6-0-1. Zulip searches for the issue key and baseDefinition/implements wording found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already says baseDefinition is Resource or DomainResource and points CanonicalResource/MetadataResource interface conformance to structuredefinition-implements.
